title: Do input events reach an app while the phone is locked?
claim: The App Submission & QA Guidelines expect a beta build's core flow to run on glasses and ring input with the phone locked, and say a QR sideload dies when its WebView goes to the background. Do input events reach the app while the phone is locked, on iOS and on Android, for each install type?

evidence.note: A QR sideload ran 18 min with the iPhone locked: IMU samples kept arriving and 184 image sends, one every 5 s, all succeeded. Touch input was not reported. Android not tested.
